blocks.text: Photosynthetic pigments thylakoid membranes mein hote hain aur photosynthesis ke liye zaroori roshni ki tawanai pakarte hain. Kuch pigments yeh hain: chlorophyll a, chlorophyll b, xanthophylls aur carotenes. Mukhtalif pigments mukhtalif wavelengths (rangon) ki roshni jazb karte hain. Roshni zarraat (particles) ki dhaar ki tarah bhi baratti hai; in zarraat ko photons kehte hain. Pigment molecule ek waqt mein ek photon jazb karta hai.

blocks.title: Photon ki tawanai
blocks.text: Chhoti wavelength wale (neele) photons mein lambi wavelength wale (surkh) photons se zyada tawanai hoti hai. Zyada tawanai wale photons electrons ko zyada oonchi energy levels tak le jate hain.
Jab pigment molecule photon jazb karta hai to us ke electrons oonchi energy level par chale jate hain, aur molecule tawanai se bhar kar excited (josh mein) ho jata hai.

Chlorophyll ek lipid molecule hai. Chlorophylls kai qism ke hain: chlorophyll a, b, c aur d podon aur algae mein hote hain, jabke baqi photosynthetic bacteria mein hote hain aur bacteriochlorophylls kehlate hain.

Chlorophyll molecule ke do hisse hain: pani pasand (hydrophilic) sar aur pani se door rehne wali (hydrophobic) dum. Sar porphyrin ring ka bana hai jo chaar pyrrole rings (paanch kone wale, nitrogen wale compounds) se banta hai. In chaar rings ko beech mein ek magnesium atom jorta hai. Chlorophyll-a mein doosri pyrrole ring par methyl (CH₃) group hota hai, jabke chlorophyll-b mein usi jagah aldehyde (CHO) group hota hai. Porphyrin ring roshni jazb karti hai. Dum lambi hydrocarbon chain hai jo molecule ko thylakoid membrane mein jamaye (anchor) rakhti hai.

Chlorophylls zyada tar violet-blue aur orange-red roshni jazb karte hain. Sabz (green) roshni sab se kam jazb hoti hai; yeh guzar jati ya palat (reflect) jati hai, isi liye patte sabz nazar aate hain.

blocks.title: Carotenoids
blocks.text: Beta-carotene jaise carotenoids photosynthesis mein dohra kirdar ada karte hain: yeh spectrum ke neele aur sabz hisse ki roshni pakarte hain, aur zyada roshni se photosynthetic nizam ko nuqsan se bachate hain.

Accessory (madadgar) pigments chlorophyll-a ke ilawa woh tamam pigments hain jo photosynthesis ke liye roshni jama kar sakte hain. Chlorophyll b ek accessory pigment hai; baqi carotenoids (carotenes aur xanthophylls) aur phycobilins hain. Chlorophyll b aur carotenoids podon mein milte hain, jabke phycobilins red algae aur cyanobacteria mein.

blocks.alt: Chaar pyrrole chhallon ka porphyrin ring; har chhalle ka nitrogen atom beech ke magnesium atom se jura hai. Side groups: ring I par vinyl group (H2C=CH) aur CH3, ring II par R aur CH2-CH3, ring III par CH3, ring IV par H3C, aur ek paanchwan chhalla jis par C=O aur COOCH3 group hai. Ring IV se CH2-CH2 zanjeer ek ester group par khatam hoti hai jo lambi hydrocarbon zanjeer (chain) se juri hai. Key: R = CH3 chlorophyll a mein; R = CHO chlorophyll b mein.

blocks.text: Jab accessory pigments roshni jazb karte hain to woh tawanai chlorophyll a ki taraf aage barha dete hain. Aam khayal hai ke podon mein tawanai is tarteeb se muntaqil hoti hai:

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sar (head) porphyrin ring hai jis ke beech Mg hai; yahi hissa roshni jazb (absorb) karta hai aur pani pasand (hydrophilic) hai. Lambi dum (tail) hydrocarbon hai jo pani se door bhagti (hydrophobic) hai aur thylakoid membrane mein dhansi rehti hai. Chlorophyll a aur b mein sirf ring II ka R group mukhtalif hai: a mein CH₃, b mein CHO.

Woh graph jo dikhaye ke koi pigment kaun kaun si wavelengths jazb karta hai, us pigment ka absorption spectrum kehlata hai. Chlorophylls ka absorption spectrum batata hai ke neeli roshni (430 nm) aur surkh roshni (670 nm) sab se zyada jazb hoti hai. Carotenoids ki jazb ki chotiyan (peaks) chlorophylls se mukhtalif hain (Fig 5.5-a). Photosynthesis ka action spectrum bhi dikhata hai ke neeli aur surkh roshni sab se zyada asar-daar hai. Yani photosynthesis ka action spectrum pigments ke absorption spectrum se mel khata hai.
Kuch wavelengths jo chlorophyll-a jazb nahin karta, chlorophyll-b unhein achi tarah jazb karta hai, aur ulta bhi. Is farq se dono chlorophylls mil kar roshni ki zyada wavelengths jazb kar lete hain.

blocks.alt: Rangeen spectrum ke upar do graph, wavelength 350 se 700 nm. (a) Absorption of light: chlorophyll-a (bhari lakeer) ki chotiyan taqreeban 430 aur 662 nm par, chlorophyll-b (tooti lakeer) 453 aur 642 nm par, carotenoids (nuqtedar) taqreeban 420 se 480 nm ke darmiyan; saath legend.

blocks.long_description: Rangeen spectrum ke upar do graph, wavelength 350 se 700 nm. (a) Absorption of light: chlorophyll-a (bhari lakeer) ki chotiyan taqreeban 430 aur 662 nm par, chlorophyll-b (tooti lakeer) 453 aur 642 nm par, carotenoids (nuqtedar) taqreeban 420 se 480 nm ke darmiyan; saath legend. (b) Photosynthesis rate / absorption rate: action spectrum (kaali lakeer) neeli aur surkh roshni mein ooncha aur sabz mein neecha hai; absorption spectrum (surmai hissa) us ke neeche hai aur us ki neeli aur surkh chotiyan milti hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein dekhein har pigment kis rang ki roshni zyada jazb karta hai: chlorophylls neeli aur surkh, carotenoids neeli-sabz. Sabz roshni bohat kam jazb hoti hai, is liye patte sabz nazar aate hain. (b) mein photosynthesis ki raftar (action spectrum) wahin oonchi hai jahan pigments zyada roshni jazb karte hain; yeh sabit karta hai ke jazb hui roshni hi photosynthesis chalati hai.
